name: Washington-state-law-embedding-model-Large
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from BAAI/bge-large-en-v1.5 (config.json max_position_embeddings 512). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: bidirectional encoder (BERT), full attention, no causal mask
notes: ADDED 2026-11-01. A finetune of BAAI/bge-large-en-v1.5 (335M BERT-large, hidden 1024, 24 layers, 512 max positions, 1024 output dims) on synthetic municipal drafts mapped one-to-one against Washington State RCWs. Same config.json and tensor set as the base. Licence apache-2.0, repo created 2026-04-20. The card's evaluation table prints an explicit 'Base Model (Untrained Large)' column beside the finetuned column, measured on the same held-out validation split, so this is a clean same-table base comparison — but the corpus is a private synthetic legal set, not a public benchmark, and the base was re-run by the authors rather than quoted. Metrics are screenshot-free markdown, all four recorded. The card reports peak validation performance at epoch 3.02; note that peak-on-validation is an optimistic selection and no separate test split is reported. BGE retrieval requires the 'Represent this sentence for searching relevant passages:' query prefix, which the card warns about and which affects reproducibility if omitted.

benchmarks.name: RCW retrieval Recall@10
